title: Touch control held key
shortDescription: Touch control reports a key pressed for too long.
fullDescription:
Bosch induction cooktops show E0001 when the control sees a key held longer than ten seconds at startup. Liquid spills, a wet cloth, or an object resting on the glass usually cause it.

The cooktop locks until the surface is clear and dry.

fixSteps.title: Wipe dry
fixSteps.instruction: Dry the entire glass and remove anything resting on it.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Cut the cooktop breaker for 5 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Replace touch module
fixSteps.instruction: If it persists with clean dry glass, replace the touch board.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the glass looks damaged or if it persists after cleaning.

faq.a: A wet sponge can trigger the same touch as a finger.

title: Zone over-temperature
shortDescription: Cooking zone exceeded its safe limit.
fullDescription: E0002 indicates a thermistor measured an unsafe glass or coil temperature. Empty pans, blocked vents, or a failing fan are typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Let the cooktop cool for 20 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Service fan
fixSteps.instruction: If the fault returns, the fan needs service.

whenToCallPro: Call when E0002 returns at low heat.

faq.a: Yes, only the affected zone locks out.

title: Mains voltage too high
fullDescription: E0005 protects against over-voltage from a lost neutral, surge, or wrong circuit. The cooktop disables itself until voltage normalizes.

fixSteps.title: Verify supply
fixSteps.instruction: Have an electrician check L-N is 120 V on each leg.

whenToCallPro: Open neutrals are dangerous; call an electrician.

faq.a: Yes, kill the breaker until verified safe.

title: Mains voltage too low
fullDescription: E0006 indicates the cooktop measured input below the operating window. Brownouts, loose breakers, or undersized wiring cause this.

fixSteps.title: Wait
fixSteps.instruction: If during peak demand, wait and retry.

fixSteps.title: Measure
fixSteps.instruction: Have an electrician measure L1-L2 at the terminal block.

whenToCallPro: Always call an electrician for panel work.

faq.a: No, induction cooktops draw too much current.

title: Coil thermistor fault
shortDescription: Coil temperature sensor reads out of range.
fullDescription: E0010 indicates the coil thermistor is open or shorted. The zone disables until the sensor reads correctly.
whenToCallPro: Most owners should call a tech for coil access.

title: IGBT thermistor fault
shortDescription: Inverter thermistor reads open or shorted.
fullDescription: E0011 means the IGBT temperature sensor is reporting out-of-range. Disabling the affected inverter is automatic.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Check the IGBT thermistor harness for chafe.

whenToCallPro: Best handled by a service technician.

title: Cooling fan failure
shortDescription: Fan tachometer signal missing or out of range.
fullDescription: E0024 indicates the fan reports no speed signal. Dust, a loose plug, or worn motor are typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Reseat plug
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect and reconnect the fan plug.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Replace if the fan does not spin.

whenToCallPro: Call if cooktop access is unsafe.

faq.a: Open kitchens pull airborne grease into the chassis.

title: Demo mode active
shortDescription: Cooktop is in showroom demonstration mode.
fullDescription: E0072 indicates demo mode is enabled, the cooktop draws no real power. Common after retail display purchases.

causes.cause: Demo mode left on by retailer

fixSteps.title: Disable demo
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the lock and minus keys for 4 seconds within the first 2 minutes after power-on to clear demo mode.

faq.q: Will demo mode damage the cooktop?
faq.a: No, it is purely a display state.

title: Configuration error
fullDescription: E0090 indicates the cooktop control cannot read or finds invalid configuration data on the power module. Often after a board swap or surge event.

fixSteps.title: Service tool reflash
fixSteps.instruction: A Bosch tech can reload configuration with a service tool.

whenToCallPro: Configuration requires a Bosch service tool.

faq.a: Boards ship blank and need site-specific config.

title: Bus communication error
shortDescription: Internal LIN bus lost a node.
fullDescription: E0511 indicates the cooktop's internal communication bus dropped a module. Loose connectors, harness damage, or a failed module are typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Service module
fixSteps.instruction: If still faulting, the power module may need replacement.

whenToCallPro: Most owners should call Bosch service.

faq.a: Often only the zones tied to the affected module.
